const chapter=document.querySelector('#chapter');const excerpts={atlas:{title:'The Quiet Atlas',text:'The map arrived on a Tuesday, folded into an envelope too small for it. Mara recognised the handwriting before she turned it over. Her father had always written the number seven with a line through its middle, as though it might otherwise wander off.

There was no letter. Only the map, a faded pencil circle around a village she had never heard of, and three words on the reverse: Start from here.

She put the kettle on. Outside, the first rain of September softened the edges of the garden. For twelve years she had known exactly where she was going. That morning, for the first time, she was not sure.'},light:{title:'Where Light Stays',text:'At closing time, the bookshop smelled of rain and warm paper. Anna was counting the coins in the till when someone knocked on the glass.

The stranger held a book wrapped in brown paper. Not a purchase. Not a return. He placed it carefully on the counter, then stepped back as though he had brought in something that might take flight.

“I think this belongs here,” he said.

Anna opened the wrapping. Inside the cover, beneath a name she almost remembered, somebody had pressed a small blue flower. Outside, the harbour lights came on, one by one.'}};document.querySelectorAll('[data-chapter]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{const data=excerpts[button.dataset.chapter];document.querySelector('#chapter-title').textContent=data.title;const box=document.querySelector('#chapter-text');box.replaceChildren(...data.text.split('

').map(text=>{const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=text;return p}));chapter.showModal()}));document.querySelector('#close-chapter').addEventListener('click',()=>chapter.close());chapter.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.target===chapter){const rect=chapter.getBoundingClientRect();if(event.clientX<rect.left||event.clientX>rect.right||event.clientY<rect.top||event.clientY>rect.bottom)chapter.close()}});document.querySelector('#reader-form').addEventListener('submit',event=>{event.preventDefault();const email=document.querySelector('#reader-email').value.trim();document.querySelector('#reader-result').textContent='Signup preview ready for '+email+'.'});
